title: One-day Boston itinerary
command: Plan a one-day visit to Boston under $100 per person, excluding lodging and travel to Boston. Use public transport and official sources; label unverified hours or prices. Do not book anything.
description: Four coordinators each delegate two research tasks.

sources.title: Boston Public Library locations and hours

specialists.title: Attractions coordinator
specialists.goal: Choose a compact set of sights grounded in official information.

researchers.title: Historic sights researcher
researchers.question: Extract access and visit details for the Freedom Trail and Faneuil Hall.

researchers.title: Public spaces researcher
researchers.question: Describe accessible public spaces and library visit constraints.

specialists.title: Food coordinator
specialists.goal: Propose meal stops without inventing menu prices.

researchers.title: Market researcher
researchers.question: Identify documented food options and hours; flag missing prices.

researchers.title: Area researcher
researchers.question: Assess meal-stop location options from these sources; keep unsupported costs explicitly unknown.

specialists.title: Transport coordinator
specialists.goal: Suggest transport consistent with the official fare and route information.

researchers.title: Fare researcher
researchers.question: Extract applicable fare amounts, units, and restrictions.

researchers.title: Route researcher
researchers.question: Explain useful subway guidance and transfers; do not invent travel times.

specialists.title: Schedule coordinator
specialists.goal: Check opening hours and construct a feasible order with explicit assumptions.

researchers.title: Opening-hours researcher
researchers.question: Extract opening hours and date restrictions, labeling anything unavailable.

researchers.title: Budget researcher
researchers.question: Identify verified costs and unknown costs. Do not claim the $100 cap is proven when prices are missing.
